title: Father's Residual Soul
next_chapter_hook: The figure about to dissipate cast one final glance at Chen Ji, lips moving, leaving a name that sent chills through his body—Ling Yuan.

text.content: At the end of the corridor, candlelight flickered, sketching that figure in an ethereal outline. Chen Ji stopped, pupils contracting—that brow, those eyes, that contour were unmistakably his father's features, long blurred in memory. His throat moved, forcing himself to stay composed, while hidden in his sleeve his fist clenched tight. Ten years. He thought he'd buried that longing deep in his heart, but now it was like having a wound torn open, bleeding profusely.

The phantom slowly turned, and a faint light flickered in those hollow eye sockets. Gazing at Chen Ji, a complex smile emerged on his withered features—resembling both a cherished masterpiece crafted with a lifetime's dedication, and a profound sin that caused him deepest remorse. The residual soul's presence was barely perceptible, yet when it looked at Chen Ji, it seemed to condense slightly.

dialogue.content: Trembling with emotion, yet suppressing it) You... truly Father? Ten years ago, that fire—I watched your remains burn to ashes.

text.content: The phantom gently shook his head, his voice drifting like from an immense distance, fragmented yet crystal clear: "That fire... I ignited it myself." He raised his nearly transparent palm, softly brushing Chen Ji's face, yet passing through without contact. "Ji'er, you've grown. Even more exceptional than I anticipated..."

choice.prompt: Facing his father's residual soul, Chen Ji felt ten years of suppressed questions and resentment churning within. At this moment, he chose...

choices.description: Why did you deceive me? You were alive all along, yet made me an orphan for ten years!
choices.risk_hint: Potentially causing the residual soul to dissipate faster

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes reddened. For the first time in ten years, cracks appeared on that perpetually calm face. He grabbed the phantom's arm, but his fingers pierced through the虚无, grasping nothing. "Do you know how I survived?" His voice was hoarse. "Everyone called me a废物, stepped on me—I thought I was an unwanted child—" Before finishing, he abruptly stopped, realizing his loss of composure.

choices.description: Since Father has appeared, there must be a reason. I'll hear him out first, then decide.
choices.risk_hint: Missing the opportunity for emotional catharsis

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly pressing the churning emotions back into his chest. He stepped back half a pace, clasped his hands in salute, his posture respectful yet近乎疏离. "Since that's the case, please explain, Father—what was the purpose of that fire? Why is the Tianji Record in my possession?" His voice regained its usual composure, only the slight tremor in his fingertips betraying his true feelings.

The residual soul gazed at Chen Ji, the light in his eyes gradually intensifying, as if seeing through him to glimpse another's shadow. After a long silence, he let out a bitter sigh: "The Tianji Record... is a curse I inscribed into your body." His form grew more illusory, yet his voice suddenly became heavy. "When Heaven chose me to inherit this object, I lacked the strength to bear it. I could only divide it into three parts, hiding them within you and Nian. You thought it was fortune? No, Ji'er—it is a shackle."

"Every time you peer into Heavenly Secrets, you burn your lifespan and Heavenly Fate." The residual soul slowly raised his hand, pointing to Chen Ji's heart. "How much Heavenly Fate do you have left now? Thirty? Twenty?" His voice carried unmistakable guilt. "When it reaches zero, your soul will scatter. I lit that fire to sever Ling Yuan's pursuit—he never wanted the Tianji Record, but through you, to resurrect something... far more terrifying."

choice.prompt: After learning the truth of the Tianji Record, Chen Ji faced a difficult choice...

choices.description: Having come this far, there's no turning back. At least I can protect Xiao Nian.
choices.risk_hint: Heavenly Fate depleting continuously, nearing death

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes,沉默了许久. The residual soul静静地等待着, as if already anticipating his choice. Finally, Chen Ji raised his head, a bitter smile appearing at the corner of his lips. "Since it's a shackle, I'll wear it and forge a path." His voice was low yet firm. "Since Father entrusted me with the Tianji Record, surely he also calculated this moment—I won't disappoint you."

choices.description: If the Tianji Record is a shackle, there must be a way to break it. Since Father dared to divide it, why can't I completely sever it?
choices.visible_cost: Coming into conflict with Father's legacy
choices.visible_reward: Potentially obtaining clues to break the shackle
choices.risk_hint: Offending the residual soul, missing the chance for emotional reconciliation

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze sharpened abruptly. Beneath that habitually restrained mask, a hint of resolute锋芒 emerged. "I don't believe in absolute destiny in this world." He spoke word by word. "Since Father could divide the Tianji Record, I can completely destroy it—or turn it to other purposes." Upon hearing this, the residual soul's form fluctuated violently, his eyes flickering with a complex expression of astonishment and relief.

The residual soul静静地 listened to Chen Ji's words, a complex light flickering in his eyes. After a long while, he suddenly smiled—that smile was like letting go, like liberation. "Good, good..." His form grew increasingly faint, yet his voice suddenly became solemn. "Ji'er, the clue to breaking the shackle lies with Ling Yuan—he holds the final page of the Tianji Record, which records the method of 'Heavenly Fate Remolding.' But be careful, he won't give it up easily..."

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan? The former Patriarch of Tianqing Sect? What was his relationship with Father?

text.content: The residual soul's outline had begun to dissipate, his voice growing fainter, like a candle flickering in the wind making its final struggle. "He is... my senior brother... also one chosen by the Tianji Record yet passed over..." His voice trailed to silence, though his lips still moved. The final wisp of residual soul turned to scattered light, slowly dissipating before Chen Ji's eyes, only that familiar aura lingering indefinitely.

Chen Ji stood rooted in place, gazing at the direction where his father dissipated,许久没有动弹. The fluorescent light fell on his shoulders, hair tips, like the raindrops falling on umbrella surfaces when Father sent him to school on that rainy night ten years ago. He stretched out his hand, wanting to touch those points of light, yet his fingertips only met cold虚无. His eyes ached, and he forcefully blinked, forcing that hint of moisture back.

dialogue.content: In a low voice) I will find that last page. Whatever Ling Yuan wants... I will take it from him.

text.content: The words fell, and suddenly a low laugh rang out from the darkness. Chen Ji spun around, only to see at the corridor's end, a black shadow slowly approaching. That person wore Tianqing Sect elder attire, face aged yet eyes sharp—one was precisely Tianqing Sect's former Patriarch, Ling Yuan. His lips carried a meaningful smile, as if had been waiting here for a long time. "Chen Ji, were you satisfied with your father's words?"

dialogue.content: Composing himself,恢复平静) The Elder visits late at night—may I ask what brings you here?

text.content: Ling Yuan stepped closer slowly, each step carrying overwhelming pressure. His gaze swept across where Chen Ji had stood moments before, where a few strands of unfaded fluorescent light lingered. "Your father schemed until the very end—truly my worthy junior brother." His tone carried a trace of mockery. "Unfortunately, he miscalculated one thing—the final page of the Tianji Record was never in my possession." He paused, gazing meaningfully at Chen Ji. "It has always been deep within Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds, waiting for the true inheritor to retrieve it."

choice.prompt: Faced with Ling Yuan's sudden appearance and provocation, Chen Ji needed to respond...

choices.description: Since the Elder knows the secrets of the Tianji Record, surely you know what you want. Why not speak frankly?
choices.visible_cost: Exposing his desire for the Tianji Record's secrets
choices.risk_hint: Being caught by Ling Yuan's weakness

text.content: Chen Ji slightly bowed, his posture flawless in deference, yet a knowing smile appeared on his face. "Since the Elder knows the situation, surely you understand this junior's predicament." His voice was unhurried. "I wonder what price the Elder would offer for what this junior possesses?" Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, seemingly surprised by this废物 disciple's composure, his smile growing deeper.

choices.text: Enduring and showing weakness,暂时 retreating
choices.description: Ling Yuan's cultivation is unfathomably deep—this is not the time for combat. Better to leave first, investigate the Forbidden Grounds secretly.
choices.visible_reward: Preserving strength, avoiding exposing trump cards
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan may follow in secret

text.content: Chen Ji lowered his eyes, concealing all sharpness, presenting a panicked, anxious appearance. "This junior... this junior doesn't understand what the Elder means." He stepped back, clasped hands in salute. "If there's no other instruction, the disciple takes his leave." Ling Yuan watched his performance, a playful glint flashing in his eyes, yet didn't obstruct—only spoke meaningfully: "Go. I will open the road to Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds for you."

After Chen Ji left, the corridor returned to silence. Ling Yuan stood alone, gazing at the remaining fluorescent light, an complex expression appearing on his aged face. He raised his hand, and an ancient令牌 appeared in his palm—the token of the Tianji Record inheritor, also the obsession he had pursued for decades. "Junior brother, you thought hiding the Tianji Record could protect him?" His voice was low like an abyss. "Those chosen by the Tianji Record never control their own fate."

Meanwhile, Chen Ji walked alone on the path shrouded by night, moonlight stretching his shadow very long. Father's residual soul's words still echoed in his ears—the Tianji Record is a shackle, Ling Yuan is the senior brother, when Heavenly Fate reaches zero it's death... all clues intertwined in his mind, weaving an impenetrable net. He suddenly stopped, raised his head to gaze at the cold moon in the heavens, a self-mocking弧度 appearing at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: Internal monologue) Father, when you chose to bear everything alone back then, was it because you didn't want me to follow the same doomed path? Unfortunately... your son was never a chess piece to be manipulated.

text.content: He clenched his fist, knuckles whitening. The night wind brushed past, lifting his robes, also dispersing some of the郁气 suppressed in his chest. The road ahead is long, thorns everywhere, but he already has no retreat. Tianqing Sect's Forbidden Grounds, Ling Yuan's scheming, Heavenly Fate's countdown... every step is a life-or-death drama. Yet Chen Ji, this Chen Ji, is determined to slash a bloody path through the desperate situation.

In the distance, a faint light suddenly appeared in the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak—that was where the Inner Disciples' quarters were—Su Qingyao's room. Chen Ji gazed at that faint light, his eyes softening momentarily, then regaining their cold sharpness. That woman who probed him repeatedly probably never imagined that the "truth" she had been investigating had tonight unveiled just the tip of the iceberg.
